insights.text: Vuori is uniquely balanced: 46% women's / 37% men's. Alo skews 31% women's, Gymshark 21% men's.
Vuori's earth tone palette (15%) is +9% vs industry avg—reinforcing California lifestyle positioning.
Jogger battle: Vuori (162) vs Lululemon (205). Gap of 43 to close.
Leggings opportunity: Lululemon has 207 vs Vuori's 183. Gap of 24 SKUs.
Neutrals (black/white/gray/navy) = 45% of Vuori's palette. Core basics that drive repeat purchases.
Vuori leads Lululemon in men's: 1572 vs 1286 products. A 22% advantage.
Vuori ranks #2 in shorts with 760 products. Behind Gymshark (1412).
Outerwear depth: Vuori has 547 products vs Lululemon's 680. Key for cooler weather expansion.
